title: lomatium donnellii
intro: Lomatium donnellii, commonly known as Fernleaf Biscuitroot, is a perennial plant native to the western United States and Canada, belonging to the family Apiaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections, such as the common cold and flu. The therapeutic actions of Lomatium donnellii include immunomodulation, antiviral, and antifungal activities, making it a valuable herb for supporting immune system function and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include alkaloids, glycosides, and terpenoids, including ligustilide and butylphthalide, which have been shown to possess significant pharmacological activity.
